mapper.select: SELECT omur.member_id, m.member_name, omur.user_id, sa.scope_org_id AS level_id, l.level_name FROM org_member_user_rel omur LEFT JOIN org_member m ON m.id = omur.member_id LEFT JOIN sys_account sa ON sa.user_id = omur.user_id LEFT JOIN org_level l ON l.id = sa.scope_org_id WHERE omur.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
